simple.meaning: אָחַר (ʼâchar) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to loiter (i.e. be behind); by implication to procrastinate.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 17 times in Genesis, Exodus, Deuteronomy, Judges, 2 Samuel, and 6 more, beginning at Genesis 24:56. The surrounding contexts include family, family line, flock, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אָחַר (H309) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: אָחַר (ʼâchar) / H309 is traced through Genesis 24:56, Genesis 32:5, Genesis 34:19, Exodus 22:28 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.short: to loiter (i.e. be behind); by implication to procrastinate
definitions.usage: continue, defer, delay, hinder, be late (slack), stay (there), tarry (longer).
definitions.full: H309. achar אָחַר verb to remain behind, delay, tarry (Arabic to put off , also to remain behind ; Aramaic Pa`el אֵחַר , Aph`el , Shaph`el , Sabean אחֿר Osiander ZMG 1865, 197 ; אחֿחֿר DHM Epigr. Denkm. 34 ). Qal once only Gen 32:5 וָאֵחַר (contracted from וָאֶאֱחַר compare אֵהָ֑ב Prov 8:17 ) and I have tarried until now. Pi`el Perfect אֵחַר Gen 34:19 ; אֶחֱרוּ Judg 5:28 ; Imperfect תְּאַחֵר יְאַחֵר, (3 t. תְּאַחַ֑ר ) etc. Gen 24:56 9 t.; Participle ( רֵֿי ) מְאַהֲרִים 3t. 1 intensive , delay, tarry , absolute Judg 5:28 (|| לָבוֺא בּשֵׁשׁ ) Isa 46:13 and my salvation תְאַחֵר לֹא Hab 2:3 ; Psalm 40:18 = Psalm 70:6; Dan 9:19 ; with ל & infinitive Gen 34:19 . — Prov 23:30 עַלהַֿיָּיִ֑ן מְאַחֲרִים those tarrying over the wine, Isa 5:11 בַנֶּשֶׁף מְאַחֲרֵי , Psa 127:2 שֶׁבֶת מְאַחֲרֵי (|| קוּם מַשְׁכִּימֵי ). 2 causative of Qal , cause one to delay, hinder Gen 24:56 ; keep back (= bring late ) Exod 22:28 ; with ל & infinitive delay to . . . Deut 23:22 quoted Eccl 5:3 : elliptical Deut 7:10 he delayeth (it, the recompense) not to his enemy. — 2Sam 20:5 Qr וַיּ֫וֺחֶר is taken by Ol § 241 c as Qal (compare וַתֹּ֫חֶז 20:9 from אָחַז ), by Sta § 498 c Kö 1. 397 Ges § 68 2Rem as Hiph`il (literally shewed, exhibited delay ): on the Kt (? וַיֵּיחַר ) see Dr Sm .
